observations: Normal-eye view gains neutral nonuniform dampness while keeping the existing tile layout and joints legible.
Close view preserves granite grain and shallow groove scale through the unchanged normal map; the roughness partition reads as damp stone rather than green pooled water or mirror plastic.
The fixed offline light does not create a reliable bright wet reflection. Native IBL/light and KTX loading determine whether that aspect is acceptable on PICO.
constraints_satisfied: No new light, geometry, water overlay, material type, node, map count or layout.
Only two generated 1024 square maps replace material8 base-color and MR images; material8 normal stays unchanged.
Material count remains 32 and image count remains 50.
conclusion: Offline visual first piece is acceptable for Root native material review. It is not an APK, device, KTX-loading, reflection, collision or Space Pro performance acceptance.
